titre: Capital mondial dédié à la réassurance
sous_titre: Milliards de dollars, fin 2024, fin 2025 et projection fin 2026

2024.texte: Total capital stood at US$607 billion a year earlier

2025.texte: Global dedicated reinsurance capital rose to US$663 billion at year-end 2025, an all-time high

2026 (projection).texte: Total dedicated reinsurance capital will reach $705 billion by the end of 2026, up from $663 billion
